activity_statements.statement: develops and sells industrial automation software and hardware (PLCs, drives, SCADA) to manufacturing companies globally
provides building automation systems (Desigo platform) controlling HVAC, energy, fire safety, and facility management for commercial buildings
supplies rail electrification, signaling, and train control systems for urban transit and intercity rail operators
delivers industrial AI and digital twin software enabling factories to design, simulate, and optimize production before physical build
operates grid technology and power distribution equipment for electric utilities and infrastructure operators
partners with NVIDIA to build industrial AI and industrial metaverse platforms for accelerating product development

segments.name: Siemens Healthineers (medical tech — now separate company)

name_reality_gap: Index labels it 'Automation Machinery Manufacturing' — accurate for legacy identity but misses that Siemens is now primarily a software and digital technology company: its industrial automation division is led by software-defined systems, digital twins, and AI platforms, not traditional machinery.
extraction_notes: About page gave high-level domain overview; building automation product page gave concrete detail. Rail and grid segments inferred from company's well-known structure and about page references. Siemens Healthineers was spun off as a public company but Siemens still holds significant stake — included minimally.
